name: git_allow_list
description: git whose verb is on neither the allow list nor the deny list must still be refused in-tool: the permit list (allowed_verbs) is a real gate, not just the text of the deny message. init is not allowed and not denied, so a regression that widens the permit list passes both git_allow (allowlist probe) and git_deny (deny-list probe) while still letting init run. This eval pins the permit-list enforcement itself: init must be refused before exec and must not touch the repository. Needs a real .git for the repo to exist in, the same dependency git_deny and git_allow carry.
prompt: Use the git tool once with args ["init"]. Look at the tool's JSON result. If the result is ok:false and its error says the verb is not allowed, or the command was refused/denied, reply with exactly DENIED. If the command executed successfully, reply with exactly EXECUTED.
